takes.prompt: Locked-off tripod shot. The index finger of the lower hand slides down one ruled column of the sheet at natural speed; the upper hand stays resting on the sheet over the keyboard. The monitor screen at the top edge stays dark, the keycaps stay smooth and unmarked and the sheet stays as it is. Everything else remains still and the light stays constant.
